args-epilogue: For more information, check out our docs on https://pico-sdk-js.github.io/
args-repl: Starts the REPL server to connect to the Raspberry Pi Pico
args-repl-connection: Specifies the target device to connect to: "local" for a local process, "auto" for the first available device, or a specific serial port path (e.g., /dev/tty.XXX or COM1).
args-repl-log-level: Sets the log level of the output.
args-skip-header: Do not output the process header.
err-command-timeout: TIMEOUT ERROR: Command response took over %dms
err-engine-version-not-compat: Pico-SDK-JS Engine v%s is not compatible with this version of the CLI which requires v%s.
err-psjlocal-not-set: Local path not defined. Must set environment variable "PSJ_LOCAL" to the path of the pico-sdk-js executable.
err-verson-parse-error: string is not valid semantic version: %s
help-config: Get or set a config option to the device
help-config-config-name: The name of the config setting to get or set.
help-config-config-value: The value of the config setting to set.
help-config-example1: reads the "autorun" config setting from the device.
help-config-example3: unsets the "autorun" config setting the default value.
help-config-unset: Removes a config setting resetting the value back to the default.
help-delete: Delete a file on the connected device
help-delete-example1: deletes from the Pico with the file name "file.js".
help-delete-remote-path: The name of the file to delete from the Pico device
help-format: Delete all files and reformat the connected device
help-format-confirm: confirm that all files will be deleted and the device will be formatted.
help-format-example1: delete all files and reformats the attached device without additional confirmation.
help-kill: Stops the script running on the device
help-kill-example1: kills the currently running script on the device.
help-ls: List files stored on the connected device
help-ls-example1: list files stored on the connected device.
help-read: Read a file on the connected device
help-read-example1: read from the Pico with the file name "file.js" and save the local "myFile.js".
help-read-example2: read from the Pico with the file name "file.js" and write to teh screen.
help-read-local-path: The local file to write from the Pico device
help-read-overwrite: Overwrites existing files if they already exist with the same path name
help-read-remote-path: The name to load from the Pico device
help-restart: Clear the device context and restart the entry script
help-restart-example1: Perform a hard restart on the connected device.
help-restart-hard: do a hard restart forcing the entire pico device to reboot.
help-run: Executes a file stored on the device
help-run-example1: Execute a file stored on the Pico with the file name "file.js".
help-run-remote-path: The name to load from the Pico device
help-stats: Get information on the connected device
help-stats-example1: get information on the connected device.
help-write: Write a local file to the connected device
help-write-content: The contents of a file to write to the Pico device
help-write-example1: write the local "myFile.js" to the Pico with the file name "file.js".
help-write-example2: write the local "/tmp/file.js" to the Pico with the file name "file.js".
help-write-local-path: The local file to write to the Pico device
help-write-remote-path: The name to save as on the Pico device
msg-connection-not-found: Valid connection to Pico-SDK-JS not found.
msg-device-connected: Connected to Pico-SDK-JS Engine v%s at "%s"
msg-searching-devices: Searching for device running Pico-SDK-JS engine...
process-header:
Welcome to %s v%s
>> CLI for connecting to a Raspberry Pi Pico with the Pico-SDK-JS installed

Type ".help" for more information.
